name: Broken Hearts
overview: Scripture reveals that God is near to those with broken and contrite hearts, offering salvation and healing to those who humbly come to Him in repentance. The Psalms emphasize that a broken spirit and heart are not despised by God but are the sacrifices He values. Believers are encouraged to cast their burdens upon the Lord, trusting in Him fully rather than relying on their own understanding, for He sustains and strengthens the heart even in times of weakness. Ultimately, God binds up the wounds of the brokenhearted, providing enduring strength and comfort.
